meta.title: Capability Router
meta.description: Discover and call installed DSH tools on demand. Search MCP and plugin capabilities by Chinese keywords, exact names, or source, and fetch full parameters only when needed to reduce tool-definition overhead. Supports pinned tools, complete catalog pagination, parameter and version checks, while preserving DSH permissions, native image attachments, and session recovery. Optional managed MCP connections provide cached discovery, first-call connection, and idle reaping for stateless services. Describe your task naturally without manually switching tools.
